scalePolicy: One isotropic factor/source from median six neutral crown to actual dark boot sole; nearest resample only, never pose fit/mirror/head transplant.
sourceMaskPolicy: Measured whole source bodies and all their opaque disconnected hand/hair fragments; preserve raw; no uniform-cell cap clipping or neighbor fragments. Alpha128 body threshold only, raw RGBA retained.
rootPolicy: Actual dark boot sole for upright. Running anatomical ground / actual supported footprint + explicit lift; prone actual source boot endpoint/ground contact, manual evidence, never ivory hem/hair/pole bottom. Seated support ground recorded separately. Native canvas padding only.
socketPolicy: Each source pose actual palm/cuff reviewed. Idle/run and hit bind the same actual raised front pole arm; cast from charge uses separate ground-planted pole while hands seal/command. Open/hidden palms have no held claim; source wrist delta relative own same-view neutral, with explicit estimates when hidden.
phaseMapping: Key4 starts Core ART release600/900. Pole planted on ground from chargekey2; SW clasp readiness plantedkey1. Core fact alone creates contact/pulse, no body-driven early hit. Source gesture may open while charging without contact authority.
rowCompletenessPolicy: Derive actual counts from source. Seated3 or other valid distinct counts allowed with source mapping; no cloning to fill forecast. Run terminal standing excluded, action recovery same-source neutral7 allowed when anatomy needs, recorded reuseReason.
approvalPolicy: Technical gate does not approve new Banner ART/motion/runtime. No changes to Sword/V1/runtime/map/DB.
